caption: The drawing consists of nine rectangular swatches, each featuring a different fabric pattern arranged in a 3x3 grid on a plain, off-white background. The top row contains: a swatch with small, repeating floral motifs in black and pink; a swatch with blue and pink floral patterns; and a beige swatch decorated with small, black abstract shapes. The middle row includes: a swatch with alternating light blue and dark gray floral sprays; a pattern of blue and pink flowers; and a beige swatch covered in small, scattered red floral elements. The bottom row features: a swatch with large red botanical shapes; a pattern of small, black abstract motifs; and a design with looping red lines and purple dots on a beige background. Each swatch is outlined by a thin, dark border, and the overall composition is neatly arranged on a textured paper surface. The left bottom corner has the text "Edith Mayoretete" printed in small letters.
title: Printed Quilt Patches
